title: STD-1: Publish MCP server to the registry
body:
**Owner:** **staff**
**Trigger:** none
**Done check:** register entry `mcp-registry` moves from planned to supported with a passing test
**Status:** closed

Namespace verification is owner-only; held until the license review allows public listing.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 248.3 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
